subject: Custody bridge dry-run: control-plane divergence & failback play
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Suzanne Martin <suzanne.martin@globalbank.com>, Paul Chen <paul.chen@asia-hosting.com>, ops-team@globalbank.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Custody bridge dry-run: control-plane divergence & failback play

Team — looping you in for the dry-run we agreed with Global Bank next week. High-level ask: run a controlled custody-bridge exercise that simulates a control-plane divergence between EU primary and APAC warm-standby, validate egress gating, KMS key sync behavior, and execute the pre-agreed failback.

Objectives (30–45m):
- Trigger a control-plane split on the private VPC pair (EU primary / APAC standby) and observe routing decisions.
- Validate that egress gating rules prevent cross-border egress for tenant GB-CUST-01.
- Verify KMS key rotation/sync doesn't break active sessions and that we can rekey without data loss.
- Execute failback within the RTO/RPO targets and capture timing metrics.

Artifacts attached: dryrun-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook + checklist). Please review and call out missing pre-reqs.

Data we need captured (pre-populate if possible):
- Per-request routing traces (trace_id mapped to tenant)
- KV-cache snapshot and validation hash pre/post-exercise
- Tokenized egress logs with geo-tags (egress-gating-capture-*.csv)
- KMS sync logs for key IDs used by GB-CUST-01

Schedule suggestion: Nov 2 14:00 GMT (EU morning, APAC late evening). Suzanne — can your ops team confirm that window?

Marissa
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: dryrun-runbook-v1.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Suzanne Martin <suzanne.martin@globalbank.com>, Paul Chen <paul.chen@asia-hosting.com>, ops-team@globalbank.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Custody bridge dry-run: control-plane divergence & failback play

Thanks Marissa — reviewed the runbook. A few edits and requests before we lock the window:

1) KMS: add a pre-step to export current key metadata and validate key IDs against the backup KMS in APAC. If possible, capture a sample re-encryption transaction.
2) Monitoring: we should add an immediate alert if any tenant session drops > 1% during the split. Add alert runbook references.
3) Rollback: include an expedited rollback path that preserves KV cache (we'll test both cache-preserving and cache-evacuate failbacks).

I can update the runbook and push v1.1 by EOD. Also attaching the KMS collection command snippets to the drive link so GB ops can prepare their side.

Naomi
Director, Infrastructure Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-03T16:42:00+01:00
Subject: RE: Custody bridge dry-run: control-plane divergence & failback play — post-run notes and artifacts

Team — ran the dry-run as scheduled. Short postmortem and immediate action items below. I've uploaded all capture artifacts to the shared folder (link below) and attached the aggregated egress sample.

Summary:
- Control-plane divergence behaved as expected: traffic preference stayed pinned to EU primary for the test tenant when the split triggered; APAC accepted warm-standby states but did not serve requests for the scoped tenant due to egress gating.
- KMS: during the simulated rekey, there was a ~6s window where the session library attempted an out-of-band KMS call; the retry logic handled this without user-visible failures, but we saw a token refresh spike. See kms-sync-log-20261102.tar.gz for raw output.
- Failback: cache-preserving failback completed in 92s (within RTO). Evacuate-and-rehydrate path took 9m. We recommend defaulting to cache-preserve when available.

Action items (owner):
- Karthik: add an alert threshold for token-refresh spikes > 3x baseline during KMS rotation (due EOD 2026-11-05).
- Naomi: update runbook to v1.2 with KMS command examples and evidence hashing steps (due 2026-11-04).
- Marissa: coordinate compliance evidence handoff to Global Bank (include hash manifest + timestamps).

Artifacts & links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bDryRunEvidence
- Aggregated egress sample: egress-gating-capture-20261102.csv (attached)
- KMS raw logs: kms-sync-log-20261102.tar.gz (attached)

I'll schedule a 30m readout with Global Bank compliance next week to walk the artifact set. Good work all — minimal customer impact and validate our failback defaults.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Engineering Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-sync-log-20261102.tar.gz, egress-gating-capture-20261102.csv
